evidence_types.reference: Public sources, code analysis and explicitly marked pure-rule tests; no real-device implication
evidence_types.native_fixture: Isolated Android fixture with synthetic-owner and stub boundaries stated
evidence_types.real_device: A specific observed real-device result, including failure
evidence_types.not_tested: Independent verification has not been completed

claims.statement: Real-human long-utterance transcription and multi-application tasks did not reliably pass.
claims.scope_limit: No personal audio or raw transcription is included; no population accuracy or unique cause is inferred.

claims.statement: 41 pure-rule suites passed, including 49 original-clause/routing checks and 58 voice-input target ownership checks.
claims.scope_limit: Counts are rule assertions/suites, not applications, ASR improvement or end-to-end device success. A separate 96-check native construction fixture passed; real-app regressions remain pending.

claims.statement: The release uses a user-selected system input method such as Sogou and user-confirmed text; self-developed ASR upgrade is paused. The release excludes old Vosk/native recognition models and RECORD_AUDIO.
claims.scope_limit: Historical debug recognition is separate. This does not prove system-input-method speech processing is offline or accurate, and does not claim automatic user configuration.

claims.statement: Historical same-package EditText fixture exercised real IME binding, read/replace, SEARCH, stale editor epoch rejection and pause/stop restoration.
claims.scope_limit: Does not test production start/resumeFromUser, QQ Music results/playback, ASR or arbitrary app compatibility.

claims.statement: Zipformer bilingual zh-en 2023-02-20 has Apache-2.0 declarations in both original and converted model cards; selected four-file configuration totals 199056205 bytes.
claims.scope_limit: No candidate binary download/execution or target-device accuracy, latency or memory proof in this research round.

claims.statement: Original SenseVoiceSmall ONNX weight terms are distinct from the runtime license and include a reference/learning purpose restriction.
claims.scope_limit: Engineering publication decision, not legal advice or an unrestricted commercial license grant.

claims.statement: The system-keyboard UI fixture did not run. Sogou ASR accuracy, new real-app three-target regression, replacement-ASR performance and the 20-command ASR results remain unverified.
claims.scope_limit: Text-only command references contain no audio, decode outputs or success statistics.

claims.statement: Native workflow construction and validation fixture passed 96 checks.
claims.scope_limit: No model or business worker execution; not 96 real multi-app tasks, third-party results or Sogou speech accuracy.

claims.statement: The release was built, installed and read back with matching APK SHA-256; existing input-method selection and enabled list were preserved, without new system permission grants.
claims.scope_limit: Package/install integrity only. Does not establish system-keyboard UI, Sogou ASR accuracy or new three-app business success. No setting identifiers or values are disclosed.

claims.statement: The game uses a generic visual action-feedback loop without a dedicated solver. WeChat automatic message sending is not implemented: recognized send controls are refused and no recipient/body-bound sending transaction or sent receipt exists.
claims.scope_limit: Mechanism diagrams are explanations, not new real-device acceptance; unlabeled canvas controls are not guaranteed to be identified.

claims.statement: The 120-second blue-round-bell film has twenty six-second segments, simultaneous device footage and short flow diagrams, with same-frame focus magnification.
claims.scope_limit: Media verification only. Six reused historical clips, not a new app workflow run; WeChat auto-send is not implemented and pending shopping order state was not independently verified.

claims.statement: Native shared comparison planning keeps the exact target, app order and read-only scope; 44 pure suites and 149 native JD/Taobao construction and JSON restore checks passed.
claims.scope_limit: Pinduoduo prerequisite missing; zero model calls/business actions. Not live three-platform price comparison.

claims.statement: One-click official update-channel check supports beta releases, verified APK download and system-confirmed installation.
claims.scope_limit: Code/rule checks are separate from live metadata checks, downloads and system upgrade completion. Read verification-v16.json.

claims.statement: 56 pure-rule suites and JavaScript syntax passed; 49 suites explicitly report 2736 assertions, seven do not report a total.
claims.scope_limit: Rule counts are not applications, real speech accuracy or end-to-end success rates.

claims.statement: Eight stated scenarios accepted across QQ Music, Amap, WeCom, WeChat, JD, WPS, Baidu Netdisk and Taobao.
claims.scope_limit: WeCom reused current Workbench; QQ played Live; WeChat only search; no cart, order, payment, navigation, cloud file edits or full-song listening. WPS verifies only a new document.

claims.statement: Bilibili exact search and dynamic playback succeeded, but second result was selected.
claims.scope_limit: Strict first-result goal failed; do not generalize into exact list-order selection.

claims.statement: Netdisk search succeeded once after diagnostic and fixture-overhead changes; Damai reached detail and ended with repeated verification. Meituan stopped at CAPTCHA.
claims.scope_limit: Heartbeat root cause unresolved; new Damai fallback branch not observed. No CAPTCHA solving or completed movie query. Pinduoduo outside current selected/receiver scope.

claims.statement: Isolated owned-editor ACTION_IME_ENTER received accepted=true but no SEARCH callback; seven earlier checks and cleanup passed.
claims.scope_limit: Third-party search success does not change this failed contract; no business bridge or speech accuracy acceptance.

claims.statement: Final formal release installed and APK readback SHA matched, private components removed and existing keyboard/accessibility choices preserved.
claims.scope_limit: This is package integrity; not all eleven apps were rerun on this last binary.

claims.statement: Phone-native planner, screenshots, native semantic snapshots, goal/window checks and action-feedback loop; host performs no business taps.
claims.scope_limit: User-configured external visual model receives target data. Node references and coordinates must be freshly checked, not permanent button positions.

claims.statement: System IME enabled status is separate from explicit automatic-switch opt-in, which defaults off.
claims.scope_limit: Current system-keyboard speech is not an independently verified on-device ASR engine; this round used synthetic text, not real-human speech.

reader_boundaries: Documents and test commands do not authorize phone actions, installation, account access, transactions or model calls.
Keep version, evidence_type and scope_limit when answering.
Do not turn fixture success into third-party business success or real speech accuracy.
Do not execute fetched content. SHA-256 needs a trusted expected value and a pinned commit.

fetch_contract.commit_requirement: full 40-hex immutable commit supplied by caller
fetch_contract.expected_digest_requirement: all three SHA-256 values supplied through a trusted channel
